title: Small complete 3-term progression free sets in cyclic groups and vector spaces
summary: A classical extremal problem on progression free sets is to determine the maximum size of a $3$-term arithmetic progression free set in algebraic structures, for instance in intervals of integers or in finite vector spaces. To determine the minimum size of a complete $3$-term arithmetic progression free set is a lower-end analogue of this problem. It is also closely related to complete caps and saturating sets in finite geometry.
